metadata.title: Digital Products, Automations & Integrations | Marco Galván
metadata.description: I help businesses turn operational problems into digital products, automations, integrations and internal systems built to evolve.

hero.title: I turn business problems into products and systems that work.
hero.description: I design and build digital products, automations, and integrations for founders, small businesses, and teams. I get involved from understanding the problem to launching and evolving the solution.
hero.primaryCta: Tell me what you're trying to solve

items.title: Build a product
items.description: I turn an idea, opportunity, or business problem into a digital product ready to test with real users and evolve. It may be a web app, mobile product, SaaS, or internal tool.

items.title: Automate an operation
items.description: I analyze manual processes and repetitive work to design automations, workflows, and AI solutions that reduce operational effort and errors.

items.title: Integrate or evolve systems
items.description: I connect existing tools, build new capabilities, and modernize products that need to grow without losing stability or clarity.

steps.title: Understand
steps.description: I learn about the business, its users and current operations, constraints, and the outcome we want to achieve.

steps.title: Define
steps.description: I identify the priority problem, challenge assumptions, and determine what is worth solving first.

steps.title: Design
steps.description: I evaluate alternatives and define the solution, scope, and architecture that best fit the context.

steps.title: Build
steps.description: I turn decisions into working deliveries that can be reviewed and validated throughout the process.

steps.title: Evolve
steps.description: I observe real usage, incorporate learnings, and decide with the team what should come next.

items.name: POS for retailers
items.title: A management system designed around the daily operation of a real store.
items.description: I designed and built a multi-tenant POS to centralize sales, inventory, customers, store credit, cash management, expenses, purchases, and suppliers. It is a digital product being prepared for validation with real users in a real store operation. It is not yet a consolidated SaaS.
items.role: Product strategy, discovery, MVP definition, product design, architecture, and full-stack development.

items.name: Amparo Seguros
items.title: Evolving a digital ecosystem connected to real insurance operations.
items.description: As part of the Dam Squad team, I contribute to products and systems used in Amparo Seguros' operations, working across mobile applications, backend services, internal tools, integrations, and automations.
items.role: Contribution within the Dam Squad team across product decisions, architecture, development, and systems integration.

items.name: Helmcode Cloud Products
items.title: Cloud products designed to simplify infrastructure and developer productivity.
items.description: I contributed to Andulia, HelmCloud, and Coderun: products and services for managing infrastructure, deploying containerized services, and improving developer productivity.
items.role: Architecture, full-stack development, and product evolution.

experienceSummary.title: Experience building real products
experienceSummary.text: For nearly five years, I have worked on web, mobile, and SaaS products for companies and teams across insurance, technology, education, and digital services. I currently work at Dam Squad, where I contribute to products, integrations, and automations used in real operations.

contact.title: What are you trying to solve?
contact.text: Tell me about the problem, how things work today and what you have already tried. You do not need to have the solution defined.
